verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows CrewAI persisting or checkpointing agent or flow execution so it survives process restarts or deploys, and no durable-execution integration (e.g. Temporal) is mentioned. Flows say they "manage state" and the memory system handles semantic recall, but neither describes durability. The AMP POST /resume endpoint covers resuming with human feedback, not recovery after a crash or redeploy. A competitor founder separately claims CrewAI lacks persistent states and pausing, which fits this gap.
